description: a manifest an earlier kdlith wrote, its first line the versioned marker and no provenance lines, still parses and owns its paths: a writing run over it succeeds with no KDLITH-GEN001 and replaces it with the version-free marker and the provenance lines, and the rewritten tree is current

command: sed -i -e '1s/.*/# generated by kdlith 0.1.0; do not edit./' -e '/^#@ /d' out/kdlith-manifest && head -1 out/kdlith-manifest && grep -c '^#@ ' out/kdlith-manifest; "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out out --kdlith-workspace; echo "exit=$?"; head -1 out/kdlith-manifest; grep -c '^#@ ' out/kdlith-manifest
stdout-contains:
# generated by kdlith 0.1.0; do not edit.
0
ok: generated schema crate parts-proc at out (11 owned files)
exit=0
# generated by kdlith; do not edit.
5
